hpo_admission.full_window_inequality: At HPO call, D-now >= R+30+H. Equality leaves no operational slack; observe actual timestamps/deadlines rather than infer admission from CLI.
hpo_admission.elapsed_scope: Elapsed includes input/roles/EDA/preparation and all initial experiments charged before the call. RunBudget may constrain D earlier than _run entry; use actual D, never reset elapsed there.
hpo_admission.audit_evidence: Freeze actual call/start/effective study deadline and initial-queue terminal time if available. Missing timing proof remains null/uncertified; requested args alone do not prove a full HPO window.

hpo_admission.strict_four_stage_qualification: Do not claim complete requested HPO8 stage if fewer than8 attempts or full-window proof is absent/clipped. A valid fallback CSV may still be recorded, with the stage qualification explicitly incomplete; no invented failure score.
hpo_admission.existing_handled_failure: An honestly handled ordinary failed student trial keeps its null objective and does not by itself falsify the whole completed procedure. Source/resource/clock/integrity/cleanup failure is technical failure.
